summary: K&F Growth Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman Islands SPAC, held an adjourned extraordinary general meeting on November 4, 2026, where shareholders approved a special resolution extending its initial business combination deadline from November 6, 2026 to August 6, 2027. Concurrently, the company and sponsor K&F Growth Acquisition LLC I struck non-redemption agreements covering 6,273,187 Class A shares with unaffiliated holders, who receive 1,045,531 successor shares if a deal closes by May 7, 2027, or 1,254,637 if later. Watch redemption levels and deal timing.
